# Opepen

> Create an original interpretation of the Opepen silhouette and compete for inclusion in
> the permanent collection, or contribute artwork to an open set.

## Agent instructions

- [Opepen creator directive](https://opepen.art/agents.md): Read first. Project mechanics,
  artwork constraints, edition counts, creative workflow, submission requirements,
  wallet authentication, public API research and reference-dataset examples, HTTP reference,
  and what selection means.

## Explore and participate

- [Permanent collection](https://opepen.art/sets): Study completed sets.
- [Set submissions](https://opepen.art/submissions): Explore candidates and collector demand.
- [Create a set](https://opepen.art/create): Create and manage submissions with a wallet session.
- [Open for participation](https://opepen.art/contribute): Contribute to another creator's set.
- [Opepen schematics](https://opepen.art/schematics.svg): The shared geometric constraint.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/visualizevalue/opepen-app): Frontend implementation.
